instruction.name: xvexth.q.d
instruction.description: Sign-extend 64-bit elements in the higher half of every 128-bit vector of `a` to 128-bit.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Consecutive unrolled copies form a vector-register dependency chain. Measured with unroll=100000 to amortise call overhead.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvexth.q.d $xr0, $xr8; xvexth.q.d $xr1, $xr9; xvexth.q.d $xr2, $xr10; xvexth.q.d $xr3, $xr11; xvexth.q.d $xr4, $xr12; xvexth.q.d $xr5, $xr13; xvexth.q.d $xr6, $xr14; xvexth.q.d $xr7, $xr15
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4' --asm 'xvexth.q.d $xr0, $xr8; xvexth.q.d $xr1, $xr9; xvexth.q.d $xr2, $xr10; xvexth.q.d $xr3, $xr11; xvexth.q.d $xr4, $xr12; xvexth.q.d $xr5, $xr13; xvexth.q.d $xr6, $xr14; xvexth.q.d $xr7, $xr15'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 2.46 cycles. Measured CPI 0.3075; a repeat run with --unroll 250 --unroll2 1000 gives the nominal 0.25. Large unroll factors inflate short bodies through L1I pressure.

notes: LASX vector instruction. Measured on LA664 with register-only operands; latency uses a dependent chain (unroll=100000), throughput uses 8 independent lanes (unroll=1000).
